label: FP
reason: The user-controlled data flows from request parameters through several transformations (StringBuilder, HashMap, Base64 roundtrip, split) into the 'input' variable. Crucially, before being written to the response writer, the data is passed through org.owasp.esapi.ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML(). This function properly escapes HTML special characters (<, >, &, etc.), rendering the data safe from XSS attacks in the HTML context. Thus, the reported vulnerability is a False Positive.

evidence.note: User input captured from request.getParameterNames() and assigned to param
Data reaches sink (response.getWriter()) wrapped in ESAPI encoder().encodeForHTML() which mitigates XSS
